NUMBER:
4759
 
AUTHOR:
Robert Burns
 (1759–1796)
 
QUOTATION:
Should auld acquaintance be forgot,
  And never brought to mind?
Should auld acquaintance be forgot,
  And days o’ lang syne?
 
ATTRIBUTION:
Auld Lang Syne.
